finding: A completed task's released lane/direction-lock ownership can remain visible as foreign-active staged ownership, blocking the next task commit until a manual lane adoption and WIP release sequence is performed.
expectedBehavior: Closing or releasing a task must atomically retire its direction-lock ownership before the next task can stage overlapping files; stale ownership should have a deterministic reconcile command.
evidenceOrRepro: Commit 12d5f227b adds released direction-lock recovery and candidate-scoped residue classification. scope-queue.spec.ts, task-scoped-claim-command.spec.ts, commit-bundle-resolution.test.ts, and released-wip-reclaim-transaction.test.ts pass against the production seams.
followUp: Retain the released-WIP and commit-bundle regressions; final frozen-runner publication is tracked by the four-plan release wave.
